cmd/controlplane/activation_approval.go.name: First activation approval
cmd/controlplane/activation_approval.go.description: Validates a protected one-shot approval policy and records the reviewed application activation grant.

cmd/controlplane/activation_approval_tes.name: First activation approval tests
cmd/controlplane/activation_approval_tes.description: Checks strict activation-policy parsing and rejects invalid identifiers, roles, and evidence digests.

cmd/controlplane/cohort.go.name: Cohort coordination and verification workers
cmd/controlplane/cohort.go.description: Runs protected workers that initialize approved test cohorts or validate one enrolled target per poll using FCM dry-run checks.

cmd/controlplane/cohort_approval.go.name: Approved cohort importer
cmd/controlplane/cohort_approval.go.description: Imports a reviewed, consent-backed installation roster for one application and environment through a protected database identity.

cmd/controlplane/cohort_approval_test.go.name: Cohort approval policy tests
cmd/controlplane/cohort_approval_test.go.description: Checks exact reviewed roster and evidence digest validation, and coordinator policy support for discovering eligible work without a fixed operation ID.

cmd/controlplane/held_dispatch_policy.go.name: Held dispatch bootstrap
cmd/controlplane/held_dispatch_policy.go.description: Validates a protected policy and initializes an application's dispatch profile in the held state.

cmd/controlplane/held_dispatch_policy_te.name: Held dispatch policy tests
cmd/controlplane/held_dispatch_policy_te.description: Checks environment, application, revision, and TTL validation for held-dispatch bootstrap settings.

cmd/controlplane/main_test.go.name: Control-plane command tests
cmd/controlplane/main_test.go.description: Checks policy loading, elevated work fencing, and cohort initialization and finalization.

cmd/controlplane/pilot_route.go.name: Pilot route approval and application
cmd/controlplane/pilot_route.go.description: Issues or applies a protected, application-scoped pilot route policy for an approved cohort installation.

cmd/controlplane/pilot_route_test.go.name: Pilot route policy tests
cmd/controlplane/pilot_route_test.go.description: Checks pilot-route policy parsing and validates results for approval and application modes.

cmd/controlplane/release.go.name: Dispatch release executor
cmd/controlplane/release.go.description: Applies a protected, reviewed release grant to the matching operation and runtime instance.

cmd/controlplane/release_review.go.name: Release approval and delegation
cmd/controlplane/release_review.go.description: Records protected pilot or full-release approvals and delegates reviewed release operations with evidence digests.

cmd/controlplane/release_review_test.go.name: Release review policy tests
cmd/controlplane/release_review_test.go.description: Checks release approval and delegation policies, including environment, expiry, identifiers, mode, and evidence digests.

compose.local-real-fcm.yml.name: Compose real FCM profile
compose.local-real-fcm.yml.description: Adds an explicit local profile for real Firebase delivery, mounting the supplied service-account key only in the delivery worker and keeping the dashboard and provider endpoint on loopback.

db/migrations/000053_onboarding_cohort_t.name: Remove onboarding cohort verification schema
db/migrations/000053_onboarding_cohort_t.description: Refuses rollback while cohort approvals, scopes, or target evidence remain, then removes the cohort routines and tables.

db/migrations/000053_onboarding_cohort_t.name: Create scoped onboarding cohort verification
db/migrations/000053_onboarding_cohort_t.description: Adds approved cohort scopes and per-installation targets, with locked initialization, verifier claims, result recording, and finalization routines.

db/migrations/000054_onboarding_pilot_ga.name: Restore prior PILOT transition rules
db/migrations/000054_onboarding_pilot_ga.description: Removes the onboarding-specific PILOT gate while retaining the migration safety checks for recorded state.

db/migrations/000054_onboarding_pilot_ga.name: Require verified cohort for PILOT
db/migrations/000054_onboarding_pilot_ga.description: Fences onboarding dispatch transitions into PILOT on a completed approved cohort whose exact installation and binding roster still matches pilot routes.

db/migrations/000055_onboarding_full_gat.name: Remove onboarding FULL evidence gate
db/migrations/000055_onboarding_full_gat.description: Restores the prior dispatch transition function after checking the migration rollback preconditions.

db/migrations/000055_onboarding_full_gat.name: Require delivered pilot evidence for FULL
db/migrations/000055_onboarding_full_gat.description: Fences PILOT-to-FULL on current approved cohort bindings with provider acceptance and signed DELIVERED receipt evidence from the same attempt.

db/migrations/000056_onboarding_dispatch.name: Remove queued dispatch release binding
db/migrations/000056_onboarding_dispatch.description: Removes the M56 binding routine and delegation trigger subject to retained-history rollback guards.

db/migrations/000056_onboarding_dispatch.name: Bind queued dispatch release grants
db/migrations/000056_onboarding_dispatch.description: Adds immutable one-to-one binding between an existing queued PILOT or FULL operation and its reviewed dispatch grant, with exact replay support.

db/migrations/000057_onboarding_activati.name: Remove scoped activation issuance
db/migrations/000057_onboarding_activati.description: Removes the scoped activation issuer routine and schema after checking that retained delegation history permits rollback.

db/migrations/000057_onboarding_activati.name: Scope first-activation issuance
db/migrations/000057_onboarding_activati.description: Adds app-scoped issuer authority and a transactional routine to issue first-activation grants through a separately authorized executor.

db/migrations/000058_onboarding_cohort_a.name: Remove cohort API functions and view
db/migrations/000058_onboarding_cohort_a.description: Drops the safe cohort status view and the scoped approval and operation-discovery functions.

db/migrations/000058_onboarding_cohort_a.name: Expose safe cohort approval and status
db/migrations/000058_onboarding_cohort_a.description: Adds a redacted cohort-target status view plus scoped approval and operation-discovery functions for the onboarding API.

db/migrations/000059_onboarding_release_.name: Remove scoped release review
db/migrations/000059_onboarding_release_.description: Drops the release reviewer registry and its approval, delegation, and supersession routines under retained-history safeguards.

db/migrations/000059_onboarding_release_.name: Add scoped dispatch release review
db/migrations/000059_onboarding_release_.description: Adds app/environment-scoped reviewer and executor roles with routines to approve release evidence, delegate a grant, and supersede unusable requests.

db/migrations/000060_onboarding_held_dis.name: Remove held dispatch bootstrap support
db/migrations/000060_onboarding_held_dis.description: Removes the bootstrap routine and protected history table only when rollback preconditions allow.

db/migrations/000060_onboarding_held_dis.name: Bootstrap initial held dispatch policy
db/migrations/000060_onboarding_held_dis.description: Adds an auditable, protected bootstrap record and a scoped routine that installs an initial HELD dispatch policy with explicit TTL settings.

db/migrations/000061_onboarding_pilot_ro.name: Remove onboarding pilot-route controls
db/migrations/000061_onboarding_pilot_ro.description: Drops the pilot-route reviewer registry and route approval/application routines subject to history safeguards.

db/migrations/000061_onboarding_pilot_ro.name: Approve and apply pilot routes
db/migrations/000061_onboarding_pilot_ro.description: Adds app-scoped reviewer/executor controls to approve and apply routes only for bindings in an approved, dry-run-verified onboarding cohort.

db/queries/onboarding_cohort_api.sql.name: Read eligible installations and cohort outcomes
db/queries/onboarding_cohort_api.sql.description: Lists bounded eligible onboarding test installations and safe per-target cohort outcomes for the staff API.

db/queries/onboarding_cohort_targets.sql.name: Coordinate cohort target verification
db/queries/onboarding_cohort_targets.sql.description: Initializes and finalizes cohort operations and claims or records individual target checks through scoped database routines.

deploy/postgres/onboarding-activation-gr.name: Install first-activation issuer grants
deploy/postgres/onboarding-activation-gr.description: Validates and grants the scoped activation-issuance function to separately provisioned issuer roles; the activation executor remains distinct.

deploy/postgres/onboarding-grants.sql.name: Install onboarding setup and verifier grants
deploy/postgres/onboarding-grants.sql.description: Grants restricted onboarding setup and verification capabilities to DBA-created roles without table-level lifecycle or dispatch mutation authority.

deploy/postgres/onboarding-pilot-route-g.name: Provision pilot-route reviewer and executor
deploy/postgres/onboarding-pilot-route-g.description: Registers a scoped reviewer-executor pair and grants pilot-route approval and application separately, without raw lifecycle-grant writes.

deploy/postgres/onboarding-release-revie.name: Provision release reviewer and executor
deploy/postgres/onboarding-release-revie.description: Registers an app/environment reviewer-executor pair and grants only release approval/delegation to the reviewer and release application to the executor.

deploy/postgres/onboarding-runtime-grant.name: Install onboarding runtime executor grants
deploy/postgres/onboarding-runtime-grant.description: Grants scoped runtime reservation and preflight functions to DBA-created executor roles; grants no table access, activation, readiness acknowledgement, or dispatch authority.

devtools/local-mobile-issuer/dashboard_c.name: Dashboard pairing control
devtools/local-mobile-issuer/dashboard_c.description: Serves a private Unix-socket endpoint that creates one-use mobile pairing QR codes for the local dashboard, separate from the issuer's LAN routes.

devtools/local-mobile-issuer/dashboard_c.name: Dashboard pairing control tests
devtools/local-mobile-issuer/dashboard_c.description: Checks dashboard QR issuance, one-use pairing codes, retained device sessions, and that the LAN handler cannot issue QR codes.

devtools/local-mobile-issuer/lan.go.name: LAN mobile issuer
devtools/local-mobile-issuer/lan.go.description: Serves scoped mobile API routes over HTTPS on a private IPv4 address, using a locally managed CA and proxying only to a loopback backend.

devtools/local-mobile-issuer/lan_test.go.name: LAN mobile issuer tests
devtools/local-mobile-issuer/lan_test.go.description: Checks that LAN certificates retain trust across host IP changes and that the HTTPS proxy allows only scoped mobile routes while preserving authentication.

devtools/local-mobile-issuer/main.go.name: Local mobile issuer command
devtools/local-mobile-issuer/main.go.description: Runs a local issuer for physical-device smoke tests, with loopback pairing or optional private-LAN HTTPS pairing; it is not a production identity or attestation service.

devtools/local-mobile-issuer/pairing_qr..name: Pairing QR helpers
devtools/local-mobile-issuer/pairing_qr..description: Builds mobile pairing links from validated loopback origins and renders one-use links as QR codes for the local smoke app.

devtools/local-mobile-issuer/pairing_qr_.name: Pairing QR helper tests
devtools/local-mobile-issuer/pairing_qr_.description: Checks pairing link compatibility, QR rendering without plaintext links, and rejection of non-loopback or malformed QR destinations.

internal/database/repository/users.go.name: Legacy user fixture repository
internal/database/repository/users.go.description: Creates a fixture user and looks it up by external identifier in the dependency integration check.

internal/fcm/verification.go.name: Firebase credential and target verification
internal/fcm/verification.go.description: Exchanges credentials for an OAuth token and validates a test device in Firebase dry-run mode.

internal/fcm/verification_test.go.name: Firebase verification tests
internal/fcm/verification_test.go.description: Checks OAuth exchange, FCM dry-run validation, and rejection of invalid policies and credentials.

internal/features/applications/onboardin.name: Onboarding test cohort endpoints
internal/features/applications/onboardin.description: Lists safe installation details and returns per-target dry-run outcomes for an application-scoped test cohort.

internal/features/applications/onboardin.name: Onboarding cohort endpoint tests
internal/features/applications/onboardin.description: Checks paginated installation listings and scoped cohort target outcomes, including pending and completed dry-run results.

internal/onboarding/cohort_postgres.go.name: PostgreSQL cohort verification store
internal/onboarding/cohort_postgres.go.description: Leases approved cohort targets, decrypts the current bound address in memory, and stores sanitized results under the exact lease fence.

internal/onboarding/cohort_verifier.go.name: Cohort target verifier
internal/onboarding/cohort_verifier.go.description: Checks one approved staging or production cohort target per run with FCM validate-only, then records fenced dry-run evidence without enabling dispatch.

internal/onboarding/cohort_verifier_test.name: Cohort verifier tests
internal/onboarding/cohort_verifier_test.description: Checks target claim validation, FCM dry-run outcomes, cancellation, and fenced evidence persistence.

internal/onboarding/redaction.go.name: Onboarding data redaction
internal/onboarding/redaction.go.description: Keeps credential policy and test-target data out of ordinary logging, string output, and protected JSON values.

scripts/integration_provider_test.go.name: Simulated provider tests
scripts/integration_provider_test.go.description: Checks that the local OAuth and FCM fixtures distinguish validation from delivery and accept only the configured synthetic targets.

scripts/local-dev/build_real_fcm_apk.py.name: Standalone Android APK builder
scripts/local-dev/build_real_fcm_apk.py.description: Builds the companion app with bundled JavaScript and the public local TLS certificate authority in an isolated checkout.

scripts/local-dev/dev.py.name: Local development stack manager
scripts/local-dev/dev.py.description: Coordinates the isolated local development stack, including startup, fixtures, dashboard checks, smoke workflows, and the explicitly selected real-FCM profile.

scripts/local-dev/real-fcm-open-runtime..name: Open local real-FCM runtime
scripts/local-dev/real-fcm-open-runtime..description: Checks the isolated database, app and held dispatch state, then opens the sealed runtime only when delivery history is empty and the preflight invariants hold.

scripts/local-dev/real_fcm_dashboard.py.name: Local device test dashboard helper
scripts/local-dev/real_fcm_dashboard.py.description: Authorizes local pairing and test actions through the dashboard session and submits test pushes through the campaign API.

scripts/local-dev/setup_test.go.name: Real-FCM target selection tests
scripts/local-dev/setup_test.go.description: Checks that selection activates only the intended Android binding and does not require other phones to disconnect.

scripts/sql/bind-onboarding-release.sql.name: Bind onboarding release grant
scripts/sql/bind-onboarding-release.sql.description: Runs the scoped database function that binds a reviewed release grant to an accepted operation and its specified runtime generation.

web/dashboard/e2e/onboarding-lifecycle-f.name: Onboarding lifecycle browser fixture
web/dashboard/e2e/onboarding-lifecycle-f.description: Provides deterministic API routes and state for browser tests of activation, test-cohort verification, and PILOT/FULL release requests.

web/dashboard/src/app/local-test-devices.name: Local test-device route gate
web/dashboard/src/app/local-test-devices.description: Enables the test-device dashboard route only for the explicitly flagged localhost real-FCM development profile.

web/dashboard/src/features/TestDevices.t.name: Local test-device dashboard
web/dashboard/src/features/TestDevices.t.description: Provides local Android pairing and test-device management, APK status, and real-FCM test sending with separate provider-acceptance and device-receipt status.

web/dashboard/src/features/admin/Onboard.name: Onboarding lifecycle dashboard
web/dashboard/src/features/admin/Onboard.description: Lets an authorized admin request activation, select and verify a test cohort, review target outcomes, and request PILOT or FULL dispatch release.
